title: Raye Says Scalpers' AI Bots "Overwhelmed" Sign-Ups For London Show
source_used: The Hollywood Reporter (own reporting, full text read)
key_facts: British singer-songwriter Raye said the sign-up for her one-off concert 'This Symphony May Contain Hope' at London's Royal Albert Hall was 'overwhelmed' by scalpers using AI bots.
She posted on social media late Monday (12 Oct 2026) that the show had 1.8 million sign-ups for a concert of about 5,000 capacity.
She said the bots caused 'hundreds of thousands of fake registrations'.
Her team is manually reviewing the sign-up list to identify a shortlist of people they believe are real fans, rather than risk a presale that scalpers could exploit.
Raye wrote that she has never witnessed bots on this scale and wants fans to be able to buy at face value.
She said she was not sure what the future holds for ticketing and that she and her team will think hard about what to do in future.
Background from THR: resale price caps are being adopted in places such as Massachusetts, Washington D.C. and Vermont; a California cap bill failed this year.
